title: Three Forms of Frequency Tables for Mosaic Displays

title: Three Forms of Frequency Tables for Mosaic Displays
text: Residual-based shading fits loglinear model data colors tiles according Pearson residuals: rij=observedij−expectedijexpectedij r_{ij} = \frac{\text{observed}_{ij} - \text{expected}_{ij}}{\sqrt{\text{expected}_{ij}}} “expected” frequencies come fitted model. Blue tiles: Observed > Expected (positive association) Red tiles: Observed < Expected (negative association) Intensity: Magnitude residual |r| > 2: Statistically significant approximately α = 0.05

title: ggmosaic2 0.5.1
text: Added facet_mosaic_grid() mosaic-aware faceting (haleyjeppson/ggmosaic#78): facet panel gets independent x/y product scales category axes drawn panel-specific positions, supports multiple mosaic layers, theme_mosaic(), coord_flip(), manual product scales, margins, residual shading. Improved Pearson residual shading: negative residuals now dark red positive residuals dark blue, matching dashed/solid cell outlines (disable via colour = NA, override colour/linetype/linewidth directly). Added custom residual legend signed labels, observed extrema, supplied limits, reference values -4/0/+4, endpoint colour squishing, collision-aware ticks/labels, vertical horizontal layouts. Fixed mosaic spacing: offset now fixed gap deepest split, gaps increasing factor 1.5 toward outer splits (previously inconsistent), converted local rectangle coordinates safely constrained small cells; offset validated single finite, non-negative value. changes spacing output relative earlier versions. Fixed namespace-use (haleyjeppson/ggmosaic#82): calls ggmosaic2::geom_mosaic() ggmosaic2::product() now work without library(ggmosaic2). Variables mapped fill alpha (colour geom_mosaic_jitter()) remain available mosaic calculation point aesthetics, longer shown automatic product axes; variables mapped x conds labeled (haleyjeppson/ggmosaic#39, haleyjeppson/ggmosaic#77). Variables can now created within geom_mosaic(), factors can reordered display. theme_mosaic() now passes additional arguments ... ggplot2::theme(). Added introducing-ggmosaic2 vignette. Lightened default geom_mosaic() tile fill (grey30 -> grey55). Fixed inst/CITATION ggmosaic2 fork: retitled ggmosaic, authors year now pulled DESCRIPTION instead hardcoded, broken multi-URL field fixed.
